trello.name: Incident write-up for ticket manipulation attempt
trello.desc: Hassan is to document the ticket manipulation attempt properly, including the raw ticket content, what the summarizer actually did, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against instruction injection
trello.desc: Wren is to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and strips or neutralizes instruction-like content before sending to the summarizer. Additionally, create a regression test using this exact ticket as a test fixture to ensure summaries stay clean. Also, implement an evaluation suite that runs multiple injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Deadline: no specific date given, approved to proceed.

trello.name: Investigate password reset issue for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren will check the password reset email delivery logs for the last week and investigate the account 'jdoe443' mentioned in the ticket. If it is a burner account, it will be closed. If password resets are broken, this will become a separate incident. Deadline: no specific date given.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan must provide Grace with a list of service accounts created since May as part of the quarterly access review preparation. Deadline: Thursday before the Friday review.
